enchantments.tooltip: Nearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.tooltip: Dexterity +13: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Insightful Dexterity +6: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Dexterity.
Quality Dexterity +3: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Dexterity.

enchantments.tooltip: Reflex Save +12: This item gives a +12 Resistance bonus to your Reflex saves.
Insightful Seeker +6: Provides a +6 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +6 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Quality Seeker +3: Provides a +3 Quality bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +3 Quality bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Tyrannical Tinkerer: While wearing two pieces from the Tyrannical Tinkerer set, you gain:
Mythic Hands Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
